newsitem.title: USA: U.S. experimental CPI +0.1 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: U.S. experimental CPI +0.1 percent in June.

text.p: The U.S. Labor Department on Wednesday released its experimental Consumer Price Index for June.
Below are percent changes for June for the experimental geometric and Laspeyres CPIs, and the official current CPI issued last week.
The experimental CPI uses two formula bases. The geometric formula differs from the official current method because it takes into account consumers' tendency to substitute among similar items.
The Laspeyres formula uses the same mathematical base as the current CPI but adds a technical adjustment to make it comparable to the geometric mean index.

Labor had previously reported that the Geometric CPI for all items was unchanged in May and decreased 0.1 percent less food and energy. The Laspeyres CPI for all items fell 0.1 percent in May. Less food and energy, it was unchanged.
